model_interpretation.claim: The correct fused candidate with up to 8192 partials measured 0.459449 ms, while the 16384-partial variant measured 0.473368 ms. This candidate keeps approximately 4096 elements per partial until the cap, then limits the count to 4096; at the largest input that halves finalizer fan-in versus 8192 partials but also halves first-stage CTA count. It tests whether the cheaper finalization offsets reduced large-input parallelism. No speedup is assumed.
model_interpretation.transformations: {"files":["src/candidate.cu"],"retained":["Fuse fabsf(input[i]) into a first-stage block sum so no full-size absolute-value array or output initialization pass is needed.","Set partial_count to ceil(n/4096), capped at 4096; partition the input into contiguous CTA chunks and use scalar loads with a conventional 256-thread CUB BlockReduce.","Reduce all current-call partials in one final CTA and directly overwrite output; explicitly zero output for non-positive n."]}

model_interpretation.claim: With 1024 CTAs of 256 threads, the prior fused four-accumulator streaming loop checks each future element on every iteration. Processing only complete groups of four in the hot loop and handling at most three tail elements afterward may reduce predicate/control overhead while preserving each lane's input order, the global tile traversal, partial count, and finalizer organization. The candidate remains unmeasured; correctness and full-call time must be checked by the controller.
model_interpretation.transformations: {"files":["src/candidate.cu"],"retained":["Reconstruct the measured fused two-stage topology with a fixed 1024-CTA, 256-thread input stage and fixed 1024-partial CUB finalizer.","Keep the four independent per-thread accumulators and lane ownership; run unconditional loads only when all four strided elements are valid, then predicate the remaining tail loads once after the loop.","Retain the existing two-kernel launch structure and write all partials and the output on each call."]}

items.subject: Mapping T3 avec le partitionnement à 4096 partiels de T1
items.objective: Partir de T1 (4096 partiels) et tester le mapping intra-CTA de T3 (quatre accumulateurs, traitement du groupe final), en conservant 4096 partiels et un finaliseur cohérent. Valider tous les cas et mesurer l’appel complet; ne présumer aucun gain de combinaison.
